description: M2 hazard contact: spawn (48, 32), walk east until the player overlaps the hazard column at x=420-500 in m2_debug_strip. Verify terrain.hazard_contact_or_avoidance fires with damage_applied > 0 and actor HP drops. 110-tick walk lands player center at ~440 (inside hazard); 30-tick settle covers the 6-tick event debounce.
